Primary: on-call incident commander. Required specialists: service, database/recovery, identity, privacy, safety/moderation, and release owners as the affected boundary requires.

Declare and contain

Open a durable incident record, establish severity/commander/time line, and use aggregate identifiers. Never paste tokens, secrets, raw addresses, provider subjects, emails, handles, comment bodies, or deletion-ledger ciphertext into chat/tickets. Preserve relevant immutable release, audit, and checksummed evidence with access restricted to responders.

Protect anonymous reading while containing narrower writes:

  • for a Plan 03 incident, close DOCLING_EXPERIMENT_ENABLED first, then VERSION_DIFF_ENABLED, RESEARCH_MEMORY_ENABLED, ANNOTATIONS_ENABLED, ASSISTANT_V2_ENABLED, VISUAL_OBJECTS_ENABLED, SEMANTIC_FACETS_ENABLED, PAPER_PASSPORT_ENABLED, and finally DEEP_READER_ENABLED as the affected dependency requires. Preserve private artifacts, legacy Introduction/source access, and schema 24. A parser rollback returns to the last proven GROBID configuration and does not merge adapters;
  • on a private-research exposure, stop the affected routes and telemetry export, preserve access-restricted evidence, keep account deletion available when safe, and verify the mobile ordinary-SQLite cleanup boundary. Do not describe the Drift database as application-layer encrypted or deploy an unreviewed SQLCipher/key migration during containment;
  • on a reading-feed invariant or queue-authority alert, close TO_READ_FIRST_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED first. Close NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED before SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED, then READING_BRIEFS_ENABLED and RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED, before closing READING_FEED_ENABLED; the optional event stream may close independently. Never fall through to recommendations when authority is unknown;
  • close PAPER_TITLE_SEARCH_ENABLED and LIBRARY_IMPORT_WRITES_ENABLED independently for search/import incidents, and close PAPER_RESOLUTION_ENABLED only after both consumers are off;
  • close NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED before SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED, and close READING_BRIEFS_ENABLED before the reading feed, for engagement incidents;
  • close RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED and the independent RECOMMENDATION_EVENTS_ENABLED for ranking, feedback, explanation, or event incidents. While reading feed remains on, only its minimal authority-bound Recent fallback may continue, still behind proven emptiness and the final revision recheck; this must not expose recommendations over an unverified queue;
  • close SAVED_QUERIES_ENABLED before SEARCH_EXPLORE_ENABLED, then close SEARCH_LOOKUP_ENABLED only after Explore is off. These explicit-search switches never authorize automatic feed insertion;
  • close RESEARCH_PROFILES_ENABLED for profile/privacy incidents and LIBRARY_V2_ENABLED for expanded-Library incidents while preserving their parent account/Library reads when safe;
  • freeze library writes with LIBRARY_WRITES_ENABLED=false;
  • stop new posts with COMMENT_CREATION_ENABLED=false while preserving reads, report/block, author deletion, and moderation;
  • disable account/deletion flags only when their full dependency chain is unsafe, and keep the deletion worker/ledger under privacy-owner control;
  • scale or isolate a failing paper/provider path without removing cached paper reads; and
  • withdraw telemetry ingress/export if validation or redaction fails. Mobile telemetry is best-effort and product behavior must not depend on it.

Do not destroy evidence, purge a deletion record, edit a signed ledger file, run ad-hoc destructive SQL, broaden network CIDRs, trust arbitrary forwarding headers, or lower TLS/auth validation during containment.

Triage by boundary

  • Credential/signing exposure: revoke/rotate at the provider, update the external Secret, increment secret.rotationVersion, roll all consumers, and retain prior verification/decryption keys only for bounded historical data. For a mobile signing key, follow Apple/Play compromise procedures and update association files atomically from authoritative installed-app identities.
  • OIDC outage/compromise: required-auth routes fail closed; confirm guest reading remains healthy. Revoke affected clients/sessions, preserve exact issuer/audience, and do not switch to a lookalike issuer hostname.
  • Deletion backlog/restore risk: stop account provisioning/writes if the external ledger, keys, worker permission probe, or queue safety is uncertain. Run verify-ledger; follow account-deletion.md and never skip a record.
  • Database corruption/data loss: isolate writes, select a verified recovery point, and follow backup-restore.md. The current independent deletion ledger is mandatory before traffic returns.
  • UGC abuse/moderation: preserve report/block/admin safety controls, freeze creation if ownership/SLA is overwhelmed, and follow moderation.md. Do not expose private moderation reasons.
  • Privacy/logging/telemetry: stop the affected pipeline, shorten access to preserved evidence, verify collector processors and sinks, determine the actual fields/retention window, and notify the privacy/security owner.
  • Deep Reader provenance/parser: close the narrowest Plan 03 switch, reject stale generations and invented evidence IDs, preserve original-source access, and stop new affected jobs. Treat paper text as untrusted data. Do not reprocess, re-anchor uncertain annotations, change the parser default, or publish a version diff without the reviewed trigger and rollback plan.
  • Supply-chain/image: stop promotion, identify the exact digest/SBOM/action commit, revoke provenance/signing material if implicated, rebuild from a clean reviewed revision, and rescan before rollback or rollout.

Recovery and closure

Recovery requires cause-specific tests plus guest reading, health/readiness, error/latency, database, queue, deletion, moderation, and telemetry checks. Keep schema 24 in place for the current candidate. Re-enable Plan 02 in dependency order: accounts/Library; resolution then title search and import independently; reading feed with enforcement off; Library v2 and research profiles; Lookup then Explore then saved queries; recommendations and optional events; reading briefs; subscriptions; notifications; and enforcement only after compatible-client, SLO/invariant-alert, privacy, retention, and approval gates pass. Then re-enable Plan 03 in its staged dependency order only after the exact protected gate is re-run. The historical Plan 02 rule was: Keep schema 18 in place and never downgrade to schema 11. The current equivalent never restores schema 18 merely to close Deep Reader. Observe and retain sanitized evidence after each flag. Do not run a down migration as feature containment. A database restore additionally requires successful deletion verification/reapply and privacy approval. A credential rotation additionally requires proof that old replicas and cached credentials are gone.

Record impact, detection/containment/recovery times, affected versions/data classes, decisions, notifications, evidence locations, remaining risk, and owners/dates for corrective work. Exercise at least credential exposure, provider outage, database restore/deletion replay, and comment-creation freeze in non-production. Repository tests do not count as a completed organizational incident exercise.

主要负责人： 值班事件指挥官。必需的专业负责人： 根据受影响边界，由服务、数据库/恢复、身份、隐私、安全/内容审核及发布负责人参与。

宣布事件并控制影响

创建一份持久化事件记录，确定严重等级、指挥官和时间线，并使用汇总标识符。绝不要把令牌、秘密值、原始地址、提供商主体标识、电子邮箱、用户名、评论正文或删除账本密文粘贴到聊天或工单中。保留相关的不可变发布证据、审计证据和带校验和的证据，并将访问权限限制在响应人员范围内。

控制较窄范围的写操作时，应保护匿名阅读能力：

  • 对于 Plan 03 事件，应先关闭 DOCLING_EXPERIMENT_ENABLED，再根据受影响的依赖关系依次关闭 VERSION_DIFF_ENABLED、RESEARCH_MEMORY_ENABLED、ANNOTATIONS_ENABLED、ASSISTANT_V2_ENABLED、VISUAL_OBJECTS_ENABLED、SEMANTIC_FACETS_ENABLED、PAPER_PASSPORT_ENABLED，最后关闭 DEEP_READER_ENABLED。保留私密产物、旧版 Introduction/来源访问能力和 schema 24。解析器回滚必须恢复到最后一个已验证的 GROBID 配置，且不得合并适配器；
  • 如果发生私密研究数据泄露，应停止受影响的路由和遥测导出，保留仅限授权访问的证据，在安全的情况下保持账户删除可用，并验证移动端普通 SQLite 数据的清理边界。不得声称 Drift 数据库提供应用层加密，也不得在控制事件期间部署未经审核的 SQLCipher/密钥迁移；
  • 如果阅读 Feed 不变量或队列权威性触发告警，应先关闭 TO_READ_FIRST_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED。关闭 NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED 后再关闭 SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED，随后关闭 READING_BRIEFS_ENABLED 和 RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED，最后才关闭 READING_FEED_ENABLED；可选事件流可以单独关闭。队列权威状态未知时，绝不能回退到推荐内容；
  • 发生搜索/导入事件时，应分别关闭 PAPER_TITLE_SEARCH_ENABLED 和 LIBRARY_IMPORT_WRITES_ENABLED；只有两个使用方都已关闭后，才能关闭 PAPER_RESOLUTION_ENABLED；
  • 发生互动功能事件时，应关闭 NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED，之后再关闭 SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED；同时应先于阅读 Feed 关闭 READING_BRIEFS_ENABLED；
  • 发生排序、反馈、说明或事件流问题时，应关闭 RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED 以及独立的 RECOMMENDATION_EVENTS_ENABLED。如果阅读 Feed 仍保持启用，只能继续提供受权威状态约束的最小 Recent 回退内容，而且仍须先证明队列为空并执行最终修订号复核；不得在队列未经验证时因此暴露推荐内容；
  • 关闭 SAVED_QUERIES_ENABLED 后再关闭 SEARCH_EXPLORE_ENABLED，并且只有 Explore 关闭后才能关闭 SEARCH_LOOKUP_ENABLED。这些显式搜索开关绝不授权系统自动向 Feed 插入内容；
  • 对于用户资料/隐私事件，关闭 RESEARCH_PROFILES_ENABLED；对于扩展 Library 事件，关闭 LIBRARY_V2_ENABLED；在安全的情况下保留它们所依赖的账户/Library 读取能力；
  • 使用 LIBRARY_WRITES_ENABLED=false 冻结 Library 写操作；
  • 使用 COMMENT_CREATION_ENABLED=false 停止发布新内容，同时保留读取、举报/屏蔽、作者删除和内容审核能力；
  • 只有完整依赖链不安全时，才停用账户/删除开关；删除 worker 和账本必须继续由隐私负责人控制；
  • 扩缩容或隔离发生故障的论文/提供商路径时，不得移除缓存论文的读取能力；以及
  • 如果验证或脱敏失败，应停止遥测入口/导出。移动遥测采用尽力而为方式，产品行为不得依赖它。

在控制事件期间，不得销毁证据、清除删除记录、编辑已签名账本文件、执行临时编写的破坏性 SQL、扩大网络 CIDR、信任任意转发请求头，或降低 TLS/认证验证要求。

按边界分诊

  • 凭据/签名泄露： 在提供商处撤销或轮换相关材料，更新外部 Secret，递增 secret.rotationVersion，滚动更新所有使用方；只有有界的历史数据仍需要时，才保留旧验证/解密密钥。如果移动端签名密钥受影响，请遵循 Apple/Play 的泄露处置流程，并使用权威的已安装应用身份以原子方式更新关联文件。
  • OIDC 中断/泄露： 必须认证的路由应在失败时默认拒绝；确认访客阅读仍然健康。撤销受影响的客户端/会话，保留完全一致的签发方/受众配置，不得改用外观相似的签发方主机名。
  • 删除积压/恢复风险： 如果外部账本、密钥、worker 权限探针或队列安全性存在不确定性，应停止账户预配/写入。运行 verify-ledger；按照 account-deletion.md 操作，绝不能跳过任何记录。
  • 数据库损坏/数据丢失： 隔离写操作，选择经过验证的恢复点，并按照 备份恢复运行手册 操作。流量恢复前，当前独立删除账本是必需条件。
  • UGC 违规/内容审核： 保留举报/屏蔽/管理安全控制；如果责任归属或 SLA 已经不堪重负，应冻结内容创建，并按照 moderation.md 操作。不得泄露私密内容审核理由。
  • 隐私/日志/遥测： 停止受影响的流水线，收紧对所保留证据的访问权限，验证采集器处理器和接收端，确定实际字段/保留期限，并通知隐私/安全负责人。
  • Deep Reader 溯源信息/解析器： 关闭范围最窄的 Plan 03 开关，拒绝过期代次和虚构的证据 ID，保留原始来源访问能力，并停止受影响的新任务。将论文文本视为不可信数据。如果没有经过审核的触发条件和回滚计划，不得重新处理、重新锚定不确定的批注、更改默认解析器或发布版本差异。
  • 供应链/镜像： 停止提升，查明确切的摘要/SBOM/action 提交；如果溯源信息或签名材料受到牵连，应将其撤销；从干净且经过审核的修订重新构建，并在回滚或分阶段发布前重新扫描。

恢复与结束事件

恢复需要通过针对具体原因的测试，还要检查访客阅读、健康/就绪状态、错误/延迟、数据库、队列、删除、内容审核和遥测。当前候选版本应保留 schema 24。按照依赖顺序重新启用 Plan 02：账户/Library；解析，随后分别启用标题搜索和导入；先在关闭强制执行的情况下启用阅读 Feed；Library v2 和研究资料；Lookup、Explore、已保存查询；推荐和可选事件；阅读简报；订阅；通知；最后，只有兼容客户端、SLO/不变量告警、隐私、保留策略和审批门禁都通过后，才启用强制执行。此后，只有重新执行完全一致的受保护门禁，才能按 Plan 03 的分阶段依赖顺序重新启用它。历史 Plan 02 规则是：保留 schema 18，绝不降级到 schema 11。当前对应规则是：不能仅为关闭 Deep Reader 而恢复 schema 18。每次更改开关后，都要观察并保留经过脱敏的证据。不得把执行向下迁移作为功能控制手段。恢复数据库还必须先成功验证并重新应用删除记录，并获得隐私审批。轮换凭据还必须证明旧副本和缓存凭据已经消失。

记录影响范围、发现/控制/恢复时间、受影响版本/数据类别、决策、通知、证据位置、剩余风险，以及修复工作的负责人/日期。至少应在非生产环境中演练凭据泄露、提供商中断、数据库恢复/删除重放和冻结评论创建。仓库测试不能算作一次完整的组织事件演练。
